summary.name: Merlin
summary.one_liner: Merlin is an AI chat assistant, Chrome extension and web app that gives access to multiple top AI models (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) for research, writing, coding and image creation.
use_cases: summarize web pages and YouTube videos
draft emails and social media posts
generate diagrams, mind maps and infographics
study from lecture PDFs and course bots
summary.what_it_does: Merlin provides chat access to several AI models, including ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Mistral and Llama, from one account. It is available as a Chrome extension that opens with Ctrl/Cmd+M on any site and adds buttons on Gmail, YouTube, LinkedIn and X. Users can summarize pages and videos, upload PDFs or CSV files, and build reusable Projects and custom bots. Crafts generates diagrams and charts from prompts, and the tool can produce images with several image models.
notable: One account gives access to multiple top AI models
Ctrl/Cmd+M shortcut opens chat on any website
Projects and Crafts for knowledge bases and diagrams
Works with Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo, Baidu and Yandex search
caveats: Free tier is limited to 102 queries per day, and some models (GPT-4, Gemini 1.5, Mistral large) use 30 queries per request
Paid Pro and Teams plans are mentioned for unlimited use and team pricing, with prices not fully detailed on the page
Page is mostly marketing, and the Chrome extension must be installed to use the browser features
